user.title: Add a BLLC ventilator
user.description: Connect directly to its private LAN IPv4 address. Leave the passcode blank to request the device’s existing local credential. No cloud account or app is used.

reconfigure.title: Update the local connection
reconfigure.description: The address must identify the same ventilator. Leave the passcode blank to keep the stored credential.

reauth_confirm.title: Restore local device authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the existing local passcode, or leave it blank to request it from the device. This does not reset or re-pair the ventilator.

error.cannot_connect: The ventilator did not complete local communication. Check power, address and LAN connectivity.
error.invalid_host: Enter a private LAN IPv4 address.
error.invalid_auth: The local passcode is unavailable or was rejected. Supply the existing device passcode.
error.unsupported_device: This product or protocol has not been verified for this integration.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different ventilator.

control_failed.message: The requested mode could not be confirmed by the ventilator. Its state will be refreshed from the device.
